abstract: BACKGROUND: Choriocarcinomas unrelated to pregnancy, teratomas, or germ cell tumors have been found in the stomach, lungs, colon, esophagus, bladder, breast, renal pelvis and other sites. CASE: We present a case of a 58-year-old woman with endometrial carcinoma with choriocarcinomatous differentiation. She received surgery and chemotherapy for endometrial adenocarcinoma. However, a metastatic tumor of choriocarcinomatous element appeared at the vaginal cuff 9 months after surgery. Additional chemotherapy for choriocarcinoma resulted in a decrease in the serum hCG and the tumor regressed. Fifty months following surgery, she is alive without disease. CONCLUSION: Treatment and follow-up must be performed not only for the adenocarcinoma element but also for the choriocarcinoma element in patients presenting with endometrial carcinoma with choriocarcinomatous differentiation.
abstract_ja: 背景：妊娠とは無関係に生じる絨毛癌、奇形腫、胚細胞腫瘍は、胃、肺、結腸、食道、膀胱、乳房、腎盂など他の部位でも報告されている。症例：58歳女性が絨毛癌様分化を伴う子宮内膜癌と診断され、手術と化学療法を受けた。しかし術後9か月で膣断端に絨毛癌成分の転移性腫瘍が出現した。絨毛癌に対する追加の化学療法によりヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が低下し、腫瘍は縮小した。術後50か月の時点で無病生存している。結論：絨毛癌様分化を伴う子宮内膜癌の患者では、腺癌成分だけでなく絨毛癌成分についても治療とフォローアップを行う必要がある。
